description: This file defines the BomRecord class, representing a bill of materials record with fields such as manufacturer part, store part, customer reference, pad count, and user comment. It includes a constructor and getter methods for each field.

classes.name: BomRecord
classes.description: A data class representing a BOM record with several string fields and a pad count.

methods.name: BomRecord
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all fields of the BOM record.
